transcript.text: To help narrow this down, I need to know exactly what happens when you try to use it. Does the machine have absolutely no power (no lights or display), or does it start tumbling but then stop? Also, please confirm that the door is firmly shut and you hear a click when closing it, as many dryers will not start if they think the door is open.
Lights come on but nothing happens when I press start, no sound. No click on the door either, it swings back slightly open. Door's felt loose for a few days.

The fact that there is no 'click' and the door feels loose suggests a mechanical issue preventing the door from fully latching. Most tumble dryers have a safety switch that won't allow the machine to start unless the door is securely locked; if the catch is broken or the hinge is worn, the switch never engages. Please unplug the dryer first for safety. Then inspect the plastic catch on the edge of the door and the corresponding slot in the frame. Is the catch visibly broken, bent, or missing? Also, check if the door itself feels loose or wobbly when you move it by hand. This will tell us if we are dealing with a simple part replacement (like a catch) or something more serious.
Yes the plastic tongue on the door has snapped off, found the piece on the floor. If I hold the door firmly shut and press start it runs, stops when I let go.

That suggests the issue: the plastic door catch (tongue) has snapped off. Please find the make and model number of your dryer—this is usually on a sticker inside the door frame or on the back—and let me know what it says. I can then help you identify the correct replacement part.
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]
It's a Hotpoint, but I don't know the model offhand. I'll have a look inside the door recess and tell you what it says.

That suggests the issue: the plastic door catch (tongue) has snapped off. This is a common mechanical failure where the latch breaks before the door can engage the safety switch properly. To get you the correct replacement part, I just need the full model number from that sticker inside the door recess or on the back of the machine. Once you have it, let me know and I will guide you through ordering the right part and fitting it.
